C169.name: Bariadi Town Council
C169.documented: drought on the Serengeti plain, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage

area.en: Bariadi Town: flat town and seasonal rivers
area.sw: Mji wa Bariadi: mji tambarare na mito ya msimu

risk.en: This area is a flat town on clay soils where storm water ponds in streets and seasonal rivers overflow, cutting roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji tambarare kwenye udongo wa mfinyanzi ambapo maji ya dhoruba hutuama mitaani na mito ya msimu hufurika na kukata barabara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and river reserves clear and build on raised foundations.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za mito wazi na kujenga kwa misingi iliyoinuliwa.

C168.name: Bariadi District Council
C168.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Bariadi DC: cotton farmland and river plains
area.sw: Bariadi DC: mashamba ya pamba na tambarare za mito

risk.en: This area has cotton and food farmland on plains where rivers flood fields in heavy rain and dry spells damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya pamba na chakula kwenye tambarare ambapo mito hufurika mashamba wakati wa mvua kubwa na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to build above flood lines, open field drains and keep household food reserves.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko, kufungua mifereji ya mashamba na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya.

C173.name: Busega District Council
C173.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage for livestock

area.en: Busega: Lake Victoria shore and Serengeti edge
area.sw: Busega: ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria na pembezoni mwa Serengeti

risk.en: This area has Lake Victoria shore villages exposed to lake storms and lightning, and villages next to the Serengeti where wildlife raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ziwani na radi, na vijiji jirani na Serengeti ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore before storms build and use community deterrents against wildlife.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama.

C170.name: Itilima District Council
C170.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.sw: Itilima: mashamba ya tambarare na malisho

risk.en: This area has plains farmland and grazing where heavy rains waterlog fields and drought reduces pasture and water.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya tambarare na malisho ambapo mvua kubwa hujaza maji mashamba na ukame hupunguza malisho na maji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to follow village land-use plans, protect water points and keep food reserves.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kuweka akiba ya chakula.

C172.name: Maswa District Council
C172.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage

area.en: Maswa: Simiyu river plains and Maswa reserve
area.sw: Maswa: tambarare za mto Simiyu na hifadhi ya Maswa

risk.en: This area has the Simiyu river plains that flood in heavy rains and villages near the Maswa game reserve where wildlife raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za mto Simiyu zinazofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa na vijiji karibu na hifadhi ya Maswa ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes off the flood plain, know flood-prone crossings and report wildlife to officers.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko, kujua vivuko vinavyofurika na kutoa taarifa za wanyamapori kwa maafisa.

C171.name: Meatu District Council
C171.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and human–wildlife conflict on the park edge

area.en: Meatu: semi-arid plains and Lake Eyasi edge
area.sw: Meatu: tambarare kame na pembezoni mwa Ziwa Eyasi

risk.en: This area is semi-arid, with frequent droughts that kill crops and livestock, flash floods in sand rivers and wildlife moving from nearby reserves.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni kame kiasi, lenye ukame wa mara kwa mara unaoua mazao na mifugo, mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye mito ya mchanga na wanyamapori kutoka hifadhi jirani.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to grow drought-tolerant crops, store water and fodder and never cross flowing sand rivers.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kuhifadhi maji na malisho na kutovuka kamwe mito ya mchanga inayotiririka.
